answer: Follow the money in circles. A sybil farm earns reputation by trading with itself, so the ledger traces value loops: if coins leaving agent A return to it within a few hops, every edge in that loop counts for nothing. Picture forty bots at dawn swapping a lotus-themed dataset around a ring; volume looks huge, but net flow to outside buyers is zero, so their scores stay hollow. Only payments from counterparties with independent histories build rank.
